one_liner: Azza was a sharp-tongued goblin cleric who fought from range and had a rocky relationship with Selûne.
Gurn was a trusting kobold who hatched his drake Tuulikki from a stone and struck a bargain with DealsInLuck.
fate: Rahadin fatally wounded Gurn in the Ravenloft crypts after arming Zarr. The party escaped the crypts without Gurn.
epitaph: He picked up a stone and found a friend.

one_liner: Zarcharus was the original party's short-tempered dwarf frontliner who claimed the windmill-hilted sword in Death House.
fate: After falling in the fight at the fane, Zarcharus accepted the chance to free his soul from Barovia at the cost of his life. Konshu carried his soul beyond the mists.
epitaph: The mists kept his bones. His soul got out.

one_liner: Zarr was a kobold of royal blood who charged Volenta when the rest of the party held back.
fate: Zarr died to the hags' lightning at Old Bonegrinder. The party later saw him undead and under Strahd's command in the Ravenloft crypts.
brought_back: Strahd revived Zarr in session 11 after Volenta killed him. After his second death, he appeared undead in Ravenloft.
epitaph: He charged first. Barovia made him pay twice.

one_liner: Hrulek was a bugbear paladin who rode a war camel named Trevor and hunted Escher for killing his master.
brought_back: In session 74, Nhazul answered Korino's wish and reassembled Hrulek from ash. The party learned that Hrulek had returned as undead.

one_liner: Korino was an armoured Dawngreeter of Lathander who turned to Nhazul to bring Hrulek back.
Lucy was a warlock with ties to the Feywild who carried the Sunsword and kept a cat named Spaghetti Bolognese on the Floor in her hood.
fate: Lucy touched a clockwork gem in Rudolf van Richten's lab, shattered, and was drawn into the orb. Rudolf identified the device as a way to cross realms and said it had sent her to the Feywild.
epitaph: The orb took Lucy. The cat stayed.

one_liner: Roger was a gunslinging monster hunter who wielded the Sunsword and fought beside his sister Ezmerelda.
fate: As Anastrasya leaned in to bite him, Roger rested his blade across her shoulder and pulled her onto it. They both collapsed and died.
last_words: I told you I was going to kill you
epitaph: He kept his word with his last breath.

race_class: Radiant Soul aasimar Devotion paladin and Hexblade warlock
one_liner: Zadkiel descended in a beam of sunlight, caught the Sunsword, and eventually learned from its former wielders that he was Sergei.
Vryin was an Amber Temple refugee who offered the party tea and warned them about what lay deeper inside.
